\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 262-265 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R270-first-pass-words-from-chapters-262-265}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for despite and an excuse.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to pack, to queue, to be fined, to renew, to stick to the pan
  \item an injury, dizziness, a headache, a stomach ache, a bruise
  \item an anniversary, a festival, childhood, youth, the day after tomorrow
  \item in advance, at the same time, a decade, a century, a term
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To pack? (\textbf{\fa{بسته} \fa{بندی} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{bastebandi kardan}.) To queue? (\textbf{\fa{صف} \fa{کشیدن}}, \emph{saf keshidan}.) To be fined? (\textbf{\fa{جریمه} \fa{شدن}}, \emph{jarime shodan}.) To renew? (\textbf{\fa{تمدید} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{tamdid kardan}.) To stick to the pan? (\textbf{\fa{ته} \fa{گرفتن}}, \emph{tah gereftan}.) An injury? (\textbf{\fa{آسیب}}, \emph{âsib}.) Dizziness? (\textbf{\fa{سرگیجه}}, \emph{sargije}.) A headache? (\textbf{\fa{سردرد}}, \emph{sardard}.) A stomach ache? (\textbf{\fa{دل} \fa{درد}}, \emph{deldard}.) A bruise? (\textbf{\fa{کبودی}}, \emph{kabudi}.) An anniversary? (\textbf{\fa{سالگرد}}, \emph{sâlgard}.) A festival? (\textbf{\fa{جشنواره}}, \emph{jashnvâre}.) Childhood? (\textbf{\fa{کودکی}}, \emph{kudaki}.) Youth? (\textbf{\fa{جوانی}}, \emph{javâni}.) The day after tomorrow? (\textbf{\fa{پس} \fa{فردا}}, \emph{pas fardâ}.) In advance? (\textbf{\fa{پیشاپیش}}, \emph{pishâpish}.) At the same time? (\textbf{\fa{همزمان}}, \emph{hamzamân}.) A decade? (\textbf{\fa{دهه}}, \emph{dahe}.) A century? (\textbf{\fa{قرن}}, \emph{qarn}.) A term? (\textbf{\fa{ترم}}, \emph{term}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 266-270 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R270-second-pass-words-from-chapters-266-270}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a crossroads and a neighbourhood.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a crossroads, a neighbourhood, a building, an entrance, an exit
  \item a stadium, a capital city, a border, a rock, an ocean
  \item a gate, an awning, a greenhouse, a street gutter, a pavement
  \item only, even, completely, exactly, fortunately
  \item a shape, patience, since, despite, an excuse
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A crossroads? (\textbf{\fa{چهارراه}}, \emph{chahârrâh}.) A neighbourhood? (\textbf{\fa{محله}}, \emph{mahalle}.) A building? (\textbf{\fa{ساختمان}}, \emph{sâkhtemân}.) An entrance? (\textbf{\fa{ورودی}}, \emph{vorudi}.) An exit? (\textbf{\fa{خروجی}}, \emph{khoruji}.) A stadium? (\textbf{\fa{ورزشگاه}}, \emph{varzeshgâh}.) A capital city? (\textbf{\fa{پایتخت}}, \emph{pâytakht}.) A border? (\textbf{\fa{مرز}}, \emph{marz}.) A rock? (\textbf{\fa{صخره}}, \emph{sakhre}.) An ocean? (\textbf{\fa{اقیانوس}}, \emph{oqyânus}.) A gate? (\textbf{\fa{دروازه}}, \emph{darvâze}.) An awning? (\textbf{\fa{سایبان}}, \emph{sâyebân}.) A greenhouse? (\textbf{\fa{گلخانه}}, \emph{golkhâne}.) A street gutter? (\textbf{\fa{جوب}}, \emph{jub}.) A pavement? (\textbf{\fa{پیاده} \fa{رو}}, \emph{piyâderow}.) Only? (\textbf{\fa{فقط}}, \emph{faqat}.) Even? (\textbf{\fa{حتی}}, \emph{hattâ}.) Completely? (\textbf{\fa{کاملا}}, \emph{kâmelan}.) Exactly? (\textbf{\fa{دقیقا}}, \emph{daqiqan}.) Fortunately? (\textbf{\fa{خوشبختانه}}, \emph{khoshbakhtâne}.) A shape? (\textbf{\fa{شکل}}, \emph{shekl}.) Patience? (\textbf{\fa{حوصله}}, \emph{howsele}.) Since? (\textbf{\fa{از} \fa{آنجا} \fa{که}}, \emph{az ânjâ ke}.) Despite? (\textbf{\fa{با} \fa{وجود}}, \emph{bâ vojud-e}.) An excuse? (\textbf{\fa{بهانه}}, \emph{bahâne}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
